Interview Notice for the various posts
Tuesday, 25 July 2023
3269 Hits
This is to kindly inform that the selected candidates for the posts of Radiotherapy Technician, Assistant Embryologist, Receptionist cum Counsellor, MRI/CT Technician, and Gas Plant Operator have already been sent the interview call letters. The selection of candidates is strictly based on the details in the advertisement dated 09/05/2023. The interviews will be conducted in the
Seminar Room, Office of the Medical Superintendent
, Kasturba Hospital, Sevagram on 2
nd
August 2023. 2.00 PM onwards.
Medical Superintendent
Kasturba Hospital, Sewagram
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
